label: Гуляя
description: A 10-sentence card for гуляя, the imperfective gerund of гулять.

missions.phrase: Гуляя по парку, они говорили о планах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Front position. Гуляя is formed from the present stem of гулять (гуля-ют) plus -я. The fronted gerund names the action concurrent with the main verb говорили — they strolled while talking.
Strategic focus: End position. Here гуляя closes the sentence and runs parallel to напевала. Both actions belong to the subject она and happen at the same time.

missions.phrase: Гуляя по лесу, ты дышишь свежим воздухом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present tense. The main verb дышишь is present, and гуляя marks the simultaneous circumstance: strolling in the forest, you breathe fresh air. The gerund carries no tense ending.

missions.phrase: Гуляя вечером, человек отдыхает после работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The one who strolls in гуляя must be the one who rests — a single subject человек. A gerund cannot introduce a separate doer of its own action.

missions.phrase: Гуляя в саду, мы встретим соседей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (встретим), but гуляя stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. Strolling in the garden, we will meet the neighbours.
Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject туристы, the form stays гуляя — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike the participle гуляющие.

missions.phrase: Гуляя под дождём, она вспоминала юность.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb вспоминала is past, yet гуляя marks concurrency: while strolling in the rain, she recalled her youth. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not sequence.

missions.phrase: Гуляя медленно, дед опирался на трость.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner of a parallel action. The gerund гуляя gives the simultaneous activity while дед leaned on his cane. One subject, дед, performs both verbs at the same time.

missions.phrase: Гуляя с собакой, мальчик слушает подкаст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the masculine subject мальчик the gerund stays гуляя, taking no gender or case ending. A participle would inflect; the gerund holds one fixed shape always.

Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Влюблённые is the shared subject of both молчали and гуляя, the actions overlapping in time. The gerund compresses while they strolled into one indeclinable word.
